cases.databases_differ: MySQL and PostgreSQL refuse a text that is not UTF-8, where SQLite stores its bytes and every client refuses to read it (DIA-220, COD-69).

steps.reason: a utf8mb4 column refuses bytes that are not UTF-8 in strict mode, so MySQL stores no such text
steps.sql: INSERT INTO bind_cell (seq, label, body) VALUES (1, 'bytes', X'ff')

steps.reason: a UTF8 database refuses a text that is not UTF-8, so PostgreSQL stores no such text
steps.sql: INSERT INTO bind_cell (seq, label, body) VALUES (1, 'bytes', convert_from('\xff'::bytea, 'UTF8'))

steps.reason: SQLite stores the bytes of a cast blob as text without checking them
steps.sql: INSERT INTO bind_cell (seq, label, body) VALUES (1, 'bytes', CAST(X'ff' AS TEXT))
